llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是高熵合金的增材制造，与生物医学方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not involve biomedical materials, implant design, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选区激光熔化制备的高熵合金各向异性。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备AlCoCrFeNi2.1共晶高熵合金，表征显微组织和力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了沉积方向和扫描策略对组织和性能各向异性的影响。
summary_zh.validation: 实验测试验证了各向异性行为。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the anisotropic microstructure and mechanical properties of additively manufactured eutectic high entropy alloys.
summary_en.method: AlCoCrFeNi2.1 EHEA samples were fabricated by selective laser melting, and their microstructure and mechanical properties were characterized in different orientations.
summary_en.result: Significant anisotropy in both microstructure and mechanical properties was observed depending on the build direction and scanning strategy.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements including tensile tests and microstructural analysis were performed to validate the anisotropic behavior.

papers.title: Combination of Pericapsular Nerve Group（PENG） Block and Lateral Femoral Cutaneous Nerve Block for Total Hip Arthroplasty in a Patient with Decompensated Cirrhosis：A Case Report
papers.abstract: Pericapsular nerve group block（PENGブロック）と外側大腿皮神経ブロックにより，良好な鎮痛が得られた肝硬変合併患者の人工股関節置換術を経験した．症例は49歳男性．Child-Pugh分類Cのアルコール性肝硬変と診断されていたが両側股関節痛のため整形外科を受診，両大腿骨骨頭壊死と診断され右人工股関節置換術が予定された．全身麻酔にPENGブロック，外側大腿皮神経ブロックを併用し，良好な鎮痛，術後経過を得た．3カ月後に同様の麻酔にて左人工股関節置換術が施行されたが，経過は良好で術後3カ月で退院となった．
papers.venue: THE JOURNAL OF JAPAN SOCIETY FOR CLINICAL ANESTHESIA

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅涉及全髋关节置换术中的麻醉管理，无任何股骨假体生物力学或应力分析内容。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical case report on anesthetic technique, containing no biomechanical modeling, FEA, implant design, or stress shielding analysis relevant to hip implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 报告肝硬化合并全髋置换患者的麻醉管理经验
summary_zh.method: 采用PENG联合外侧股皮神经阻滞的麻醉方案
summary_zh.result: 患者术后镇痛良好，恢复顺利
summary_zh.validation: 仅个例报道，无对照或统计分析

summary_en.motivation: To report the anesthetic management of total hip arthroplasty in a patient with decompensated cirrhosis using a combination of PENG block and LFCN block.
summary_en.method: A PENG block combined with lateral femoral cutaneous nerve block was performed under general anesthesia for unilateral THA, with a similar approach for the contralateral side three months later.
summary_en.result: The patient achieved satisfactory analgesia and postoperative recovery without complications.
summary_en.validation: This is a single case report without comparative groups or statistical validation.
